title: top-up: model-scoped usage cooldown store
definition: Review that recordModelUsageCooldown writes only WORK_DIR/.model_usage_cooldown.json (fixed filename, atomic temp-file + rename in the same directory, expired entries dropped), that readActiveModelCooldown returns an error naming the path for an unreadable, malformed or unknown-version file and never treats it as no cooldown, and that firstModelNotCooling only steps down the injected cheaper-model ladder and stops at the cheapest rung; the store never writes .rate_limit_signal.
